# Distributed AI Research Institute

The Distributed AI Research Institute is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Oakland, California. According to its website, it is a globally distributed group of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research. The institute describes itself as believing in technology that benefits everyone and states that it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation.

The organization approaches artificial intelligence critically, asserting on its site that "AI is seldom the solution and its advance should not be treated as inevitable." It emphasizes that people should see themselves reflected in technology and advocates for thoughtful, supportive, and inclusive technologies that benefit communities. The institute appears to focus on the social and ethical dimensions of AI deployment rather than developing commercial products.
